blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will cross the river and the border via the Tancredo Neves Bridge and visit the Argentine side of the falls. The walkways and viewing platforms bring you closer to the cascades and offer views of the Devil’s Throat. The tour is accompanied by a guide.

Crossing the border requires a valid passport and compliance with Argentina’s entry requirements. The entrance tickets included will be confirmed when your trip is priced.
